_note: 學習路徑內容建置第9批 #6／6：目的 vs 結果副詞子句（eng.t_adv.advcl.purpose-result，學測級／高階）。目的（說明為什麼／目標）用 so that／in order that ＋ 子句，常配 can／could／will／would：She saved money so that she could buy a car。結果（說明真的發生了什麼）用 so ＋ 形容詞/副詞 ＋ that ＋ 子句：The box was so heavy that I could not lift it。關鍵區分：so that ＋ 主詞 ＋ 情態動詞＝目的；so ＋ 形容詞/副詞 ＋ that＝結果。高階特別防第二正解：用句構明確區分（結果句 so 後面緊接形容詞/副詞；目的句 so that 後面緊接主詞）鎖唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix acp_）。

units.title_zh: 目的 vs 結果副詞子句（so that ／ so…that）
units.can_do: 我能分辨目的副詞子句（so that／in order that ＋ 主詞 ＋ can／could／will／would，說明目標）和結果副詞子句（so ＋ 形容詞/副詞 ＋ that ＋ 子句，說明真的發生的效果），並從句子結構判斷是哪一種。
units.situation_group: 副詞子句 Purpose vs result clauses
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A purpose clause says why / for what aim, using 'so that' (or 'in order that') + a clause, often with can/could/will/would: 'He left early so that he could catch the train'.
claims.verification_ref: 目的子句＝為什麼/目標，用 so that/in order that＋子句，常配 can/could/will/would；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A result clause says what actually happened (the effect), using 'so + adjective/adverb + that' + a clause: 'The box was so heavy that I could not lift it'.
claims.verification_ref: 結果子句＝真的發生的效果，用 so＋形容詞/副詞＋that＋子句；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'so that + subject + modal' shows purpose (an aim), while 'so + adjective/adverb + that' shows result (what really happened): compare 'so that he could rest' (purpose) with 'so tired that he slept' (result).
claims.verification_ref: so that＋主詞＋情態＝目的；so＋形容詞/副詞＋that＝結果；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'in order that' is a more formal way to show purpose, similar in meaning to 'so that': 'We spoke quietly in order that the baby would not wake up'.
claims.verification_ref: in order that＝較正式的目的連接，近似 so that；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: A clause of purpose tells us why someone does something. Use 'so that' (or the more formal 'in order that') with a clause, often with can, could, will, or would: She saved money so that she could buy a car. After 'so that' usually comes a subject plus a modal verb (can/could/will/would). Be careful: 'so that' and 'in order that' are followed by a clause (subject + verb), but the similar-looking 'in order to' and 'so as to' are followed by a base verb (in order to pass), and 'due to' is followed by a noun — none of these three takes a clause.
teach.zh_hint: 目的副詞子句說明「為什麼做／目標是什麼」，用 so that（或較正式的 in order that）＋ 一個子句，常配 can／could／will／would：She saved money so that she could buy a car.（她存錢，為了能買車。）重點：so that 後面通常接『主詞＋情態動詞（can/could/will/would）』。要小心：so that／in order that 後面接『子句（主詞＋動詞）』，但長得很像的 in order to／so as to 後面接『原形動詞』（in order to pass），due to 後面接『名詞』，這三個都不接子句。

teach.body: He left home early so that he could catch the first train.
teach.zh_hint: 他很早出門，為了能趕上第一班火車。so that ＋ he（主詞）＋ could（情態）＝目的。

teach.body: A clause of result tells us what actually happened as a result. Use 'so' plus an adjective or adverb, then 'that' plus a clause: The box was so heavy that I could not lift it. After 'so' comes an adjective or adverb, then 'that'. When you describe a noun with an adjective, use 'such' instead of 'so': such + (a/an) + adjective + noun + that. Use a/an for a singular countable noun ('such a heavy box that...'), but drop it for an uncountable or plural noun ('such loud music that...', 'such tall trees that...').
teach.zh_hint: 結果副詞子句說明「真的發生了什麼效果」，用 so ＋ 形容詞/副詞 ＋ that ＋ 子句：The box was so heavy that I could not lift it.（箱子重到我搬不動。）重點：so 後面緊接『形容詞或副詞』，再接 that。若是用『形容詞來形容一個名詞』，就改用 such（不是 so）：such ＋（a/an）＋ 形容詞 ＋ 名詞 ＋ that。單數可數名詞要加 a/an（such a heavy box that…＝那麼重的一個箱子），但不可數或複數名詞就不加（such loud music that…＝那麼大聲的音樂、such tall trees that…＝那麼高的樹）。

teach.body: The music was so loud that we could not hear each other.
teach.zh_hint: 音樂大聲到我們聽不見彼此。so ＋ loud（形容詞）＋ that＝結果。

teach.body: A quick way to tell them apart: 'so that' plus a subject and a modal verb shows purpose (a goal that has not happened yet); 'so' plus an adjective or adverb plus 'that' shows result (an effect that really happened). Just look at what comes right after 'so': 'that' plus a subject and a modal means purpose; an adjective or adverb means result.
teach.zh_hint: 一眼分辨：so that ＋『主詞＋情態動詞』→目的（還沒發生的目標）；so ＋『形容詞/副詞』＋ that →結果（真的發生的效果）。看 so 後面接的是『that ＋ 主詞 ＋ 情態動詞』還是『形容詞/副詞』，就知道是目的還是結果。

teach.body: She spoke slowly so that everyone could understand, and the room was so quiet that we heard every word.
teach.zh_hint: 她慢慢地說，為了讓大家都能聽懂；房間安靜到我們聽見每個字。前半 so that＋主詞＋could＝目的，後半 so quiet that＝結果。

practice.stem: 填入正確的字：She is studying hard ____ she can pass the exam.（她用功讀書，為了能通過考試）

distractor_rationales.in order to: in order to 後面接原形動詞（in order to pass），不接『主詞 ＋ 情態動詞』she can；接子句用 so that（或 in order that）。
distractor_rationales.so as to: so as to 後面也接原形動詞（so as to pass），不接 she can；接子句用 so that。
distractor_rationales.due to: due to 後面接名詞（due to hard work），不接子句；表目的接子句用 so that。

practice.feedback: 目的、後面接『主詞 ＋ 情態動詞』的子句用 so that：She is studying hard so that she can pass the exam。

practice.stem: 填入正確的字：The music was ____ loud that we could not talk.（音樂大聲到我們沒辦法說話）

distractor_rationales.so that: so that 後面接『主詞 ＋ 情態動詞』表目的；這裡後面是形容詞 loud，表結果要用 so ＋ loud ＋ that。
distractor_rationales.such: such 要接名詞片語（such loud music that…），不直接接形容詞 loud；接 loud ＋ that 用 so。
distractor_rationales.in order that: in order that 表目的、後接子句；這裡是 so ＋ 形容詞 ＋ that 的結果結構，用 so。

practice.feedback: 結果（so ＋ 形容詞 ＋ that）：The music was so loud that we could not talk。

practice.stem: 'He whispered so that no one could hear him.' 這句的 so that 子句表示什麼？

distractor_rationales.結果（真的發生的效果）: 結果用 so ＋ 形容詞/副詞 ＋ that；這裡是 so that ＋ 主詞 ＋ could，說明他小聲說話的『目的』。
distractor_rationales.時間（什麼時候）: so that 不表時間；它表目的（他小聲是為了不讓人聽見）。
distractor_rationales.地點（在哪裡）: so that 不表地點；它表目的。

practice.feedback: so that ＋ 主詞 ＋ 情態動詞＝目的：他小聲說話，為了沒人聽得見。

practice.stem: 'The soup was so salty that I could not finish it.' 這句話表示什麼？

distractor_rationales.目的（為了什麼／目標）: 目的用 so that ＋ 主詞 ＋ 情態；這裡是 so ＋ 形容詞 salty ＋ that，說明『真的發生的效果』（鹹到吃不完）。
distractor_rationales.條件（如果…的話）: 這不是 if 的條件句；so ＋ 形容詞 ＋ that 表結果。
distractor_rationales.動作之前的原因: so…that 說明的是動作造成的『結果』，不是事前原因。

practice.feedback: so ＋ 形容詞 ＋ that＝結果：湯太鹹，結果我吃不完。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句表示『目的（為了什麼／目標）』，而不是結果？
practice.answer: We set an alarm so that we would wake up on time.
options: We set an alarm so that we would wake up on time.
We were so sleepy that we missed the alarm.
The alarm was so loud that it scared us.
It was such a loud alarm that everyone woke up.

distractor_rationales.We were so sleepy that we missed the ala: 這是 so ＋ 形容詞 sleepy ＋ that＝結果（睏到錯過鬧鐘），不是目的。
這是 so ＋ 形容詞 loud ＋ that＝結果，不是目的。
distractor_rationales.It was such a loud alarm that everyone w: 這是 such ＋ 名詞片語 ＋ that＝結果，不是目的。

practice.feedback: so that ＋ 主詞 ＋ 情態動詞（would）＝目的：設鬧鐘是為了準時起床。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: She spoke slowly so that everyone could understand, and the room was so quiet that we heard every word.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：前半目的 so that everyone could understand（so that ＋ 主詞 ＋ could）和後半結果 so quiet that we heard every word（so ＋ 形容詞 ＋ that）有沒有寫對、兩個 that 有沒有漏，slowly／every word 有沒有漏，逗號和句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。目的句 so that 輕讀帶出目標，結果句 so ＋ 形容詞稍加重點出程度，句尾下收。

lines.text: I left home early so that I would not be late.
lines.intonation: so that 輕讀、would not be late 清楚、句尾下收

lines.text: The test was so hard that many students failed.
lines.intonation: so hard 稍加重、that many students failed 清楚、句尾下收
